page.meta_description: The Eye of Horus was wounded by Set and healed by Thoth. As the wedjat it is the most common protective sign in tombs and jewelry. Related pages: Thoth.
page.content:
Wedjat — the restored eye that becomes a healing amulet.

How Eye of Horus connects

  • Character: Thoth — Thoth restored the Eye of Horus after Set wounded it.

What is Eye of Horus?

The Eye of Horus was wounded by Set and healed by Thoth. As the wedjat it is the most common protective sign in tombs and jewelry.

Key threads lead to Thoth.
